search_policy.alternatives: catalog metadata and declared file inventories only
search_policy.catalog_gate_before_exact_fetch: nondeprecated, q window, >=2 levels, catalog e<=0.001, catalog max reference spin norm<=0.0001
search_policy.exact_fetch: first catalog-qualified candidate per target; highest two levels metadata.json and ExtraWaveforms.json only
search_policy.ranking: descending highest two available resolution labels, then ascending numericSXSID; freeze all ranks before newH5 downloads; advance only after earlier candidate fails NR-only fixed gates
